page.overview:
Who is Minardil?

Minardil was the twenty-fifth King of Gondor.

Minardil was born in TA 1454 during the reign of his great-grandfather Eldacar and was the son and successor of King Hyarmendacil II whom he succeeded in TA 1621. His reign was brief and turbulent. His steward, Húrin of Emyn Arnen, would found the line of the House of Húrin, who became Ruling Stewards centuries later. In TA 1634, he was at Pelargir when it was suddenly attacked by the Corsairs of Umbar and he was slain. Minardil ruled for thirteen years. He had two sons: his eldest son Telemnar (who succeeded him) and his younger son Minastan.

Minardil is a Quenya word that means 'Tower-lover', from Minas (mutated into Minar), and the suffix -(n)dil, meaning 'lover/devoted to'.
